comments.label: Anyone can comment, but the bring-in step passes on only the comments of the owner, members and collaborators, so strangers' text never reaches the draft step. AWML can't mark this yet (awml #5)

Only people with write access and the repository's app can add a label, and GitHub holds that, not a prompt, so a stranger's comment starts nothing. The draft step's token can only read, so it can't push (awml #26)
The checks run where the draft step can't reach, and their verdict is in their own record (awml #13, #20)
Only a change to what a drawing or a page shows is pictured, and a picture that looks the same before and after is left out. A moving image only for something that moves
The reviewers and the classifier never see the drafting session, and read the patch, not the issue's thread. Their read-only token can't push, comment or merge

The description opens with the classifier's reasons and any open findings, then Claude's note as written, then what changed, the decisions the issue didn't settle, the pictures, and the issue it closes
One status comment per build. It carries a hidden marker, so a retry finds it again without passing anything between runs
GitHub starts other workflows from the app's pushes, merges and labels, but not from the Actions token's, so CI runs on the pull request
